findings.detail: Separate AAH Topco delayed-draw term-loan source rows share issuer, industry, facility, rate, and maturity but carry different par/cost/fair-value amounts, so the extracted position key is under-specified.

rationale: B02 reports 56 duplicate position keys. The raw SOI confirms at least one flagged collision: table 10 rows 7 and 10 are both AAH Topco, LLC Healthcare Delayed Draw Term Loan positions with 9.51 % interest and 12/22/2027 maturity, but they are distinct source rows with different funded par, cost, and fair value. The extracted identity collapses distinguishable source positions into the same key, so the flag is a real data defect rather than a false alarm. No aggregate anchor was needed.
